# G-Wizz, The Slayer - Agentic Browsing Registry

Welcome to the official digital hub for G-Wizz, The Slayer.

## About The Syndicate
G-Wizz is an architect of modern trap and urban-industrial hip-hop operating out of the Knysna underground.
